title: Essex Gas Company files tor approval pursuant to G.L. c. 164, § 5.03, a 244 Day Transportation Agreement with Brox Industries.
petitioner: Essex Gas Company D/B/A National Grid
filings: Letter from the Attorney General requesting that the Department defer consideration of the ratemaking aspects of this contract, pending the outcome of a generic investigation. By: John Grugan, Assistant Attorney General.

Essex Gas Company submits a letter in accordance with the Department's order of November 19, 1999 directing the Company to file a formal proposal with the Department if it wishes to pursue its proposed ratemaking treatment for this contract. By: Thomas P. O'Neil, Counsel, Eastern Enterprise.

The Department APPROVES the proposed Transportation Agreement. The Departent finds that the pricing terms under the agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore, GRANTS the Company's Request for protection form public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Janet Gail Besser, Chair; Commissioners James Connelly, Paul B. Vasington, W. Robert Keating and Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr.
Essex Gas Company's respoonse to the Department's first set of information requests. By: Thomas P. O'Neill, Essex Gas Company.
